The data can't settle this on its own, so I relied on the known signalling pathway for this dataset. The columns match the Sachs et al. flow cytometry data. In that pathway there is no direct edge between PIP2 and p44/42 (Erk). The correlation between them is weak, at 0.14. Both are linked to other proteins instead: PIP2 sits downstream of plcg and PIP3, and p44/42 is regulated by PKA and feeds into Akt. I did not run any causal-direction test, so this rests on prior knowledge rather than on the data here.

ANSWER: C
